prompt: Correct this sixteen-cell palace FLOOR COMPONENT sheet without changing any title, ID/name caption, row order or grid. ONLY change first-column A01,A05,A09,A13 and last-cell A16. For FIRST COLUMN field repeats, remove the complete room-medallion composition and every decorative perimeter frame. Each is ONE simple SQUARE thin walking tile with a SMALL closed motif occupying at most the middle half, surrounded by an uninterrupted identical plain ivory/rose marble margin on ALL FOUR EDGES, with no flourishes touching the edge. A01 small indigo/gold eight-point star with pink centre; A05 small periwinkle/rose linked petal motif; A09 small rose interlace/blue diamond; A13 small blue/pink lotus flourish. These are genuine field repeats, not another big framed room-centre medallion. A16 Suite focal quarter must be a SQUARE quarter-panel of the source rectangular suite focal inlay, NOT a circular quadrant. Show one square corner quadrant carrying the appropriate partial rose/blue central floral motif and a plain square outside perimeter; four rotations make the suite's square focal panel. Keep other three rooms' curved focal quarters, all straight borders and L corners unchanged. All floor designs are flat FLUSH marble/mineral inlays with thin gold lines, no raised gold wire or wall-like relief. Almost orthographic top-down, clean complete uncropped boundaries. No new room/scenery or extra items, captions retained exactly.

repeat_contract.units: normalized tile pitch before model fitting
repeat_contract.field_edge_rule: Plain marble margin >=0.08 pitch on all four edges; closed ornament remains within margin
repeat_contract.border_endpoint_rule: Guide-line offsets0.04/0.16 across width, identical endpoints and one complete repeat per module
repeat_contract.corner_rule: Quarter-turn with identical end profiles, same band width
repeat_contract.medallion_rule: Four rotations around one centre; focal feature, not translational field
repeat_contract.material_rule: Rose/ivory material veins vary naturally; generated reference is not a verified seamless UV texture

original_prompt:
Make a clean high-resolution named component reference sheet, not a whole room/building. Use ONLY the one supplied source for material/motif vocabulary. Owner-requested new variations and junctions must stay coordinated with it. Separate complete objects, no fused neighbors, no cropped silhouettes, no shadows over patterns, no melting scrolls or warped rails. Straight edges/columns remain straight; thin gold stays thin. Warm-white background, even light. Print exact full ID AND short name below EVERY item, title above. One object per cell, no duplicate alternate views. Palette/style follows this source. Source illustrations are not measured models; do not invent fixed palace dimensions. No people, whole buildings, scenery, plants or loose decoration glued onto parts.
